items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: why don't you tell me about Louis now that we got Johnny?

ctx.x: Just about, because you know you had similar talents. And it wasn't no more than about twenty-five to fifty cents difference one place or the other. Because I can remember Louis Armstrong coming to New Orleans here, playing something for fifty cents or seventy-five cents. I had it here someplace. I was just trying to wonder what I'd do with it.
Was that the, why don't you tell me about Louis now that we got Johnny? When's the first time you saw him in New Orleans? You saw Louis in New Orleans?
First time I saw Louis in New Orleans was 1935.
